author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with theologian Dr Jeremiah Johnston to unpack one of the most powerful and overlooked moments in the entire story of Jesus — his appearance to his own brother James. Johnston points out that Jesus' brothers did not believe in him during his ministry, his family thought he had lost his mind and even tried to stage an intervention. James was humiliated by the crucifixion and simply trying to keep the family business going when the risen Jesus appeared to him directly. That single encounter transformed James into one of the pillars of the early church and he ultimately died in 62 AD stoned to death still believing his brother was the resurrected Messiah. A deeply moving and historically grounded conversation about what it actually means that Jesus rose from the dead.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Michael Peters joins Russell Brand to expose the profound, hidden reality of sudden spiritual transformation. Michael breaks down how a lifetime of destructive habits, from the dark corners of a fraternity house back alley to dropping constant F-bombs, was instantly shattered the moment he surrendered his life to Jesus.  This is not just a story about breaking bad habits. It is a raw look at the brutal, beautiful "sine wave" of spiritual transfiguration, human suffering, and what it truly means to take up your cross daily. As Michael reveals through the lens of grace and the 12 steps, the modern world has it completely wrong. Addiction is never just a physical problem, it is a battle for your soul.

description:
Russell Brand reacts to a viral clip from the UK of a man being arrested after stating that he loves bacon in what authorities treated as a racially aggravated incident. Russell cannot hide his disbelief and uses the moment to make a broader and deeply serious point about just how far gone the United Kingdom has become under a political class that criminalises the speech and thought of ordinary citizens while ignoring genuine threats to public safety and freedom. A jaw dropping example of a country that has completely lost the plot.
